locations.name: Happy Fall
locations.description: Rolling autumn country of market towns, farms and old keeps.

locations.name: Blackmere
locations.description: A market town on the black-watered mere, under the old Keep.

locations.name: Blackmere Town Square
locations.description: Cobbles, a well, and the notice board everyone pretends not to read.

locations.name: Hearth Row
locations.description: A crooked lane of cottages with smoking chimneys.

locations.name: Blackmere Keep — Gatehouse
locations.description: The Reeve keeps office in the gatehouse. The inner Keep stays shut.

locations.name: The Lantern & Ladle
locations.description: Blackmere's tavern: low beams, a long hearth, longer stories.

locations.name: The East Road
locations.description: The road out of Blackmere, lined with leaning poplars.

locations.name: Brindle Farm Edge
locations.description: Stubble fields and a heavy-laden orchard.

locations.name: Hollowmere Woodland Edge
locations.description: Where the trees begin and the paths stop agreeing with each other.

profile.title: Innkeeper of the Lantern & Ladle
profile.greeting: Come in out of the wind. Hearth's warm, cider's cold — or the other way round, depending on the hour.
lines: Everyone in Blackmere passes through here sooner or later. Usually later.
The Reeve drinks here on market days. Don't tell him I told you.

profile.title: Proprietor, Quill's Sundries
profile.greeting: Quill's Sundries! If I haven't got it, you didn't need it.
lines: Prices move with the road. Good harvest, good prices. Bad road, well…
I buy too, you know. Bring me apples from Brindle's and we'll talk.

profile.title: Farmer, Brindle Farm
profile.greeting: Mind the furrows. They took me a week.
lines: The orchard's heavy this year. More apples than hands.
Wood's edge is lovely in the morning. Less lovely when you lose a sheep in it.

profile.title: Courier
profile.greeting: Can't stop long — letters don't carry themselves. Well. Mostly they don't.
lines: I know every road out of Blackmere and three that aren't on any map.
If the East Road's quiet, that's when you worry.

profile.title: Reeve of Blackmere
profile.greeting: State your business. Politely, if you can manage it.
lines: The inner Keep is closed by order of the Lord's steward. As it has been for eleven years.
Property in Blackmere is recorded here. Every deed, every sale.

profile.title: Traveler
profile.greeting: Another stranger! Sit — strangers should stick together.
lines: I've walked from the coast. Every town tells the same story differently.
They say something was hidden in the Hollowmere wood long ago. Everyone says that about every wood, mind.
